title: WP-07 · Plan Gate and Verify Gate shadow integration
description:
2026-09-20审计整改：当前先决条件新增J04/<issue id="f1f50085-d284-491d-92c4-a1e3d6588e60" href="https://linear.app/superpoweringwithfiles/issue/SUP-51/j04-修正t1评估与冻结独立对照协议">SUP-51</issue>（其前置J01–03）。本票暂退出night队列。具体入口遵循 docs/plans/jev-swf-audit-20260920/spec.md S5：repo侧 scripts/render-decision-checkpoint.mjs 组合现有renderCheckpoint和shadow；保持stdout字节等价，坏观测不阻断。禁止修改global skill或反向依赖repo。新增CLI/fixture不算实际接入，Chief首次真实checkpoint调用可观察后才Done。该新规格覆盖下文冲突描述。

## Task

Attach the `plan` and `verify` bundles to the existing Trio + ChiefOps checkpoint in **shadow only**, recording the recommendation without acting on it.

## Local authority

**Local authority:** `planning/active/swf-decision-control-runtime-20260919/` three files; spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-decision-control-runtime-design.md`; plan `docs/plans/2026-09-19-decision-control-runtime-plan.md`. Parent: <issue id="7dd163a7-d206-4421-8a02-e11853b146e0" href="https://linear.app/superpoweringwithfiles/issue/SUP-35/decision-control-runtime-lifecycle-semantic-gates-and-provider-neutral">SUP-35</issue>.

## Execution intent

Mode: execute
Capability: dev
Intensity: high
Topology: solo

## Scope

The decision-trace writer call site; the checkpoint path; new tests.

## Non-goals

No transition is taken from a gate output. No change to ChiefOps governance. No change to completion semantics. No duplicate readiness check.

## Done when

* A checkpoint records the shadow recommendation alongside current behaviour, including agreement or disagreement.
* A gate failure never blocks the existing path.
* A shadow run where the gate disagrees with current behaviour completes normally and records the disagreement.
* No existing checkpoint test changes.

## Verification

Targeted tests, then `npm run verify:trio`, `npm run verify:core`.

## Dependencies

WP-06 accepted.

## Night eligibility

conditional — additive and shadow-only, but it touches the checkpoint path, so the first execution should be watched rather than run fully unattended.

## Stop / replan conditions

Stop and record a blocker, or `REPLAN`, when: the recorded edit surface is not enough to finish; an existing test outside this ticket's list must change to make it pass; the plan's frozen names conflict with existing code; a human decision is needed; or the slice would need to touch another initiative's uncommitted files. Do not widen scope to work around any of these.

## Night eligibility (2026-09-19)

Remains in Backlog. Its dependency WP-06 is delivered, but the plan records this slice as night-safe **conditional** because it touches the checkpoint path and has no real caller yet; the first execution should be watched. Not queued.

## Delivery status (2026-09-19)

Delivered by direct Chief execution in the phase-8 wave as `harness/trio/core/shadow.mjs` plus `tests/trio/shadow-gate.test.mjs` (11 cases). The recorder records a shadow recommendation alongside the current behaviour with agreement or disagreement, and a gate that throws, cannot answer or cannot write its trace returns a structured result instead of blocking the existing path — verified by the `a gate failure never blocks the existing path` and `a shadow run where the gate disagrees completes normally` cases.

**One part remains open and is recorded as a limitation, not as done.** The recorder is not yet wired into the live Linear checkpoint renderer, because that file is currently modified in the sibling `linear-multiproject-isolation-20260918` working tree and this ticket's stop conditions forbid widening scope into another initiative's uncommitted files. The slice was therefore implemented additively so a checkpoint caller can invoke it. Wiring it remains gated on that path becoming free.

## Re-review / implementation slice · 2026-09-20

未接受整票：缺真实checkpoint producer调用。原recorder测试通过不等于integration完成。用户本轮授权nightly实现+离线测试；覆盖先前not queued描述。首片20分钟：识别真实producer边界与输入契约，shadow-only调用recordCheckpointShadow；测试disagreement正常完成、throw/write failure不阻塞、原checkpoint字节不变。若无真实producer不得另造状态机充数。与LMP共享文件必须串行核对owner和现有diff，保留已有更改。首次真实producer调用需白班可观察，夜班只报implementation complete / live verification pending，不得整票Done或激活gate。

title: WP-10 · Selective gate activation and baseline comparison
description:
2026-09-20审计更正：遵循 docs/plans/jev-swf-audit-20260920/spec.md S4，先做真实raw inputs/盲标签+2复核/两臂真实语义回答的T1.5，必须保留Host usage和身份可比性。原T1 26/26仅contract agreement，非独立accuracy。WP07只shadow；T2另需限定实验干预授权。全量实测usage求和，output不等于fresh，禁止减avoidedCost；+5%护栏，缺证据unproven。当前Backlog不进入night队列。

## Task

Decide from recorded evidence which gates, if any, may move from shadow to active, with a measured baseline comparison against the spec §18 benefit list.

## Local authority

**Local authority:** `planning/active/swf-decision-control-runtime-20260919/` three files; spec `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-19-decision-control-runtime-design.md`; plan `docs/plans/2026-09-19-decision-control-runtime-plan.md`. Parent: <issue id="7dd163a7-d206-4421-8a02-e11853b146e0" href="https://linear.app/superpoweringwithfiles/issue/SUP-35/decision-control-runtime-lifecycle-semantic-gates-and-provider-neutral">SUP-35</issue>.

## Execution intent

Mode: think + execute
Capability: dev
Intensity: max
Topology: solo

## Scope

The evaluation result document; the activation switch (configuration, not code); the Trio decision record.

## Non-goals

Activation of any gate is **not** automatic. No release action. No Linear telemetry.

## Done when

* Each gate is reported with its measured effect on the §18 list.
* A gate with no measured benefit stays in shadow.
* The activation switch defaults to shadow.
* A written activation decision exists per gate, with the evidence it rests on and its rollback condition.

## Verification

Reproducible comparison document; targeted tests; `npm run verify:trio`.

## Dependencies

WP-07, WP-08, WP-09 accepted.

## Night eligibility

implementation and evaluation slices may run at night; the final activation decision is **not** automatic and remains a Chief/human decision.

## Stop / replan conditions

Stop and record a blocker, or `REPLAN`, when: the recorded edit surface is not enough to finish; an existing test outside this ticket's list must change to make it pass; the plan's frozen names conflict with existing code; a human decision is needed; or the slice would need to touch another initiative's uncommitted files. Do not widen scope to work around any of these.

## Delivery status (2026-09-19)

Delivered by direct Chief execution in the phase-9 wave.

**The activation decision is: no gate is activated.** Every one of the six priority gates (`plan_needed`, `plan_ready`, `execution_ready`, `verification_sufficient`, `next_action`, `goal_complete`) stays in `shadow`.

The switch is data rather than code, appended to `harness/trio/core/shadow.mjs`, with four tests in `tests/trio/shadow-gate.test.mjs`. `resolveGateActivations()` returns `shadow` for a gate with no record, and `resolveGateActivation()` refuses to promote a gate whose record lacks a measured benefit, a rollback condition, evidence, or a Chief/human authorization — so a gate cannot reach active control by configuration accident.

The measured comparison is `docs/plans/2026-09-19-decision-control-runtime-baseline.md`, reproducible with `node scripts/evaluate-decision-shadow.mjs` (27 cases, 15 disagreements, 1 unevaluable). It states honestly that every §18 benefit is **not measured**: the fixture answers are operator inputs, so the replay proves internal consistency and totality, not a live disagreement rate. A gate with no measured benefit stays in shadow, which is why none was promoted.

## Re-review · 2026-09-20

接受维持全部shadow的决定，但整票measured baseline未完成；依赖WP07真实producer证据。实施计划：逐gate记录§18实测/unknown、来源、rollback；独立holdout/outcome不得自造。依赖满足后授权nightly离线评估/文档；不得自动激活任何gate。不再把此实现缺口伪装成人类review积压。

Mode: think
Capability: dev + office
Intensity: high
Topology: solo

`docs/` architecture and operations pages; `README` where operator-facing; the Trio record. At most, add a pointer from the two 2026-06-04 specs to this reconciliation.

## Non-goals

No commit, push, PR, merge, publish or deploy without explicit authorization. No retroactive rewrite of the 2026-06-04 specs.

## Done when

* A reader can tell what changed, what deliberately did not, and what remains limited.
* Spec §21's release boundary is restated for the operator.
* `tests/plugin-kit/docs-contract.test.mjs` and `tests/core/no-personal-paths.test.mjs` pass.

## Verification

`npm run verify:core`.

WP-10 accepted.

not eligible — external release actions are excluded.

Stop and record a blocker, or `REPLAN`, when: the recorded edit surface is not enough to finish; an existing test outside this ticket's list must change to make it pass; the plan's frozen names conflict with existing code; a human decision is needed; or the slice would need to touch another initiative's uncommitted files. Do not widen scope to work around any of these.

## Delivery status (2026-09-19)

Delivered by direct Chief execution in the phase-9 wave as `docs/decision-control-runtime.md`, with a README row and a retirement status pointer appended to each of the two 2026-06-04 specs.

The document states what changed, what deliberately did not change, the migration path, the operating instructions, seven known limitations, and a restatement of spec §21's release boundary for the operator. `tests/plugin-kit/docs-contract.test.mjs` and `tests/core/no-personal-paths.test.mjs` both pass under `npm run verify:core` (449 + 82 pass / 0 fail). No external release action was taken and the 2026-06-04 specs were not rewritten — only a status pointer was appended.

## Re-review · 2026-09-20
